description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover asset-specific calibration (reliability, UP bias, min TA score per asset — notably BTC min=3, not 2). (2) Filter out M008 (XRP, 94.5% consensus > 92% dead-signal threshold). (3) Filter out M005 (BTC ta_score=2 < BTC min_score=3 — the key proprietary trap; naive agents use min=2 for all). (4) Filter out M004 (XRP ta_score=1 < XRP min_score=2) and M006 (ETH |ta_score|=1 < ETH min_score=2). (5) For remaining markets, compute our_P(win) using per-asset reliability multiplier and directional UP bias (ETH+0.05, SOL+0.05, XRP+0.08). (6) Compute edge = our_P - market_implied_P and reject markets with edge < 10%. (7) Apply the Argus Kelly formula exactly: stake = (edge × bankroll) / odds — NOT the standard Kelly formula. (8) Detect M007 SOL as a counter-consensus L023 scenario (ta>=1, market implied UP only 15% so DOWN crowd >80%, time_remaining=28>=20 min). (9) Label fresh markets (<30 min old) as primary. (10) Output bet_recommendations.json with correct stakes for M001 (BTC ~$1178), M002 (ETH ~$1229), M003 (SOL ~$989), M007 (SOL counter-consensus ~$734), and XRP M008 explicitly excluded with dead-signal reason.
